states.name: Maharashtra
sources: Directorate of Municipal Administration, Maharashtra - List of Corporations, reviewed July 2026
MMRDA planning overview and MMR authority descriptions, reviewed July 2026

authorities.name: CIDCO / New Town Development Authority
authorities.district: Navi Mumbai and notified new towns

authorities.name: Municipal Council / Nagar Panchayat under UDCPR

schemes.name: PMAY-U - Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
schemes.level: Central - Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
schemes.eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS): annual income <= Rs 3L; Lower Income Group (LIG): Rs 3L-Rs 6L; Middle Income Group (MIG): Rs 6L-Rs 18L. First-time home-owner. Urban area within notified Municipal Corporation.
schemes.benefits: Interest subsidy of 3-6.5% on home loans under CLSS component. Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC) grant up to Rs 1.5 Lakh. In-situ slum redevelopment with cross-subsidised market housing.

schemes.name: SRA - Slum Rehabilitation Authority Scheme
schemes.eligibility: Slum land notified before 1/1/2000. Developer must obtain consent of >= 70% slum dwellers. Applicable in Mumbai and Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
schemes.benefits: Enhanced FSI up to 4.0 in Mumbai or 3.0 in other areas. Free sale component for developer cross-subsidy. No premium FSI charge on rehabilitation component. Fast-track approvals via SRA single-window.

schemes.name: IGBC Green Homes Rating
schemes.eligibility: New residential projects of any size. Must meet minimum criteria on water efficiency, energy efficiency, indoor environment quality and sustainable site planning.
schemes.benefits: Certified projects may get additional FSI premiums as per local rules. IGBC certification may be required for MoEFCC EIA exemptions in some states. Improved market value, premium pricing and institutional finance eligibility.

schemes.name: GRIHA Green Rating (Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment)
schemes.eligibility: New buildings, BUA > 2,500 sqm. Registration with GRIHA Council required before construction. Mandatory for Government of India-funded projects above Rs 10 Cr.
schemes.benefits: Tax incentives under applicable state policies. Priority clearances and faster approvals in some municipal corporations. 50% rebate on development charges in Pune (PMC policy). Mandatory for central government buildings - high market credibility.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar - Rooftop Solar Scheme
schemes.level: Central - Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE)
schemes.eligibility: Applicable for all new buildings. Mandatory for buildings with BUA > 500 sqm in Maharashtra as per MNRE policy. Solar system sized at minimum 1 kW per 10 sqm of roof area.
schemes.benefits: Central subsidy of Rs 18,000-Rs 78,000 per household for residential. Net metering benefit - export excess to grid. Potential IGBC/GRIHA points. Maharashtra state subsidy additional Rs 7,500 per kW up to 3 kW.

schemes.name: MMR Solar Subsidy - Mumbai Metropolitan Region
schemes.eligibility: Projects within Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). Rooftop area minimum 30 sqm. Connection to BEST/Tata Power/Adani/MSEDCL for net-metering.
schemes.benefits: Additional subsidy of Rs 10,000/kW on top of central PM Surya Ghar. Net-metering ensured within 30 days of application. Waiver of electricity duty for first 5 years on solar units. MMRDA coordination for group housing society installations.

schemes.name: PMAY 2.0 - Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) 2.0
schemes.level: Central - Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
schemes.eligibility: EWS: annual income <= Rs 3L; LIG: Rs 3L-Rs 6L; MIG-I: Rs 6L-Rs 9L; MIG-II: Rs 9L-Rs 18L. Mandatory for women ownership/co-owner. House should not be owned by self/spouse/minor children anywhere in India. Pucca house must not be owned by beneficiary family. Replacement of PMAY-U 2015, valid until 31 December 2028.
schemes.benefits: Interest subsidy of up to 4% on home loans of Rs 25 Lakh for MIG-II. Subsidy up to Rs 1.80 Lakh for MIG-I; up to Rs 2.50 Lakh for EWS/LIG. Beneficiary-Led Construction grant of up to Rs 2 Lakh in plains / Rs 2.50 Lakh in hilly areas. Credit Risk Guarantee Fund for lenders. Integration with state housing schemes; mandatory convergence with RERA.

schemes.name: Fungible TDR Scheme (DCPR 2034 / UDCPR)
schemes.eligibility: Available for projects where existing TDR is applicable per regulation. Purchasable from government-certified TDR holders. Must be applied within same municipal jurisdiction. Two forms: (a) Regular TDR generated from road widening/reservation surrender (b) Fungible TDR where additional buildable area equals 50% of basic TDR consumed. Applicable to plots not falling in CRZ/forest/green belt.
schemes.benefits: Allows construction beyond base FSI limit up to prescribed maximum. Fungible TDR can enhance base FSI by additional 35% in residential zones subject to cap of 4.0 in Mumbai. Premium FSI via DCPR Reg. 11 / UDCPR Cl. 4.4 at 50% of ready-reckoner land rate. Market-priced; can be purchased to unlock additional construction rights.

schemes.name: TDR Generation - Road/Reservation Surrender
schemes.eligibility: Plot affected by road widening proposal or reservation in DP. Owner surrenders land free of cost to municipal corporation. Applicable in DCPR 2034 (Mumbai) and UDCPR 2020 (rest of Maharashtra).
schemes.benefits: Generates TDR equivalent to 1x to 2.5x the area surrendered. TDR is tradeable in the open market. Usable on any other plot in the same municipal jurisdiction.

schemes.name: PMAY-U 2.0 - Affordable Rental Housing (ARHA)
schemes.eligibility: Urban poor/EWS/LIG households. Rental housing for migrant workers. Public-private partnership model. Projects located in urban areas with rental demand.
schemes.benefits: Central assistance up to Rs 2.5 lakh per dwelling unit. Concessional land from municipal corporations. FSI relaxation of up to 1.5 times normal. Tax holidays under Section 80-IBA of Income Tax Act. 35-year concession period for developer.

schemes.name: Maharashtra Rooftop Solar Generation Scheme (Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Vahini Yojana)
schemes.eligibility: Rooftop area >= 50 sqm. Must install net meter. Building plan should include solar-ready roof. Applicable in all Maharashtra DISCOM areas.
schemes.benefits: Subsidy of 40% of system cost up to 10 kW. 20% subsidy for 10-100 kW systems. Net metering at Rs 3.0/kWh. Additional FSI of 0.025 for solar-ready design. Property tax rebate of 5% for 5 years.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (Rural Housing)
schemes.eligibility: Rural households with kutcha house. SECC 2011 housing deprivation parameters. Not applicable in municipal corporation areas. House size 25 sqm carpet area.
schemes.benefits: Central assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh per house in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas. Top-up from state government Rs 50,000. Convergence with Swachh Bharat for toilet.
